entities.name: Gesù Divino Maestro alla Pineta Sacchetti
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The church of Church of Jesus the Divine Teacher at the Pineta Sacchetti is a titular church in Rome, in Balduina, in Via Vittorio Montiglio. The name refers to Jesus as the Divine Teacher, and to Pineta Sacchetti, named for the Sacchetti, a powerful family of the medieval period, and its groves of stone pines.
